Identify schools performing above or below demographic expectation

Source: R/aggregate_helpers.R
compute_outlier_schools.Rd

Fits a regression of school-level proficiency on demographic composition variables (FRL_pct, EL_pct, IEP_pct, minority_pct where available) within each year × subject, computes residuals, and flags schools exceeding outlier_sd_threshold standard deviations. Also produces funnel plot control limits and tracks outlier stability across years.

Usage

compute_outlier_schools(
  performance_data,
  spec,
  school_data = NULL,
  outlier_sd_threshold = 2,
  outlier_n_funnel = 20
)

Arguments

performance_data

Named list returned by compute_performance_trends().

spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

school_data

school_results_long, or NULL. When NULL, $outlier_characteristics is set to NULL.

outlier_sd_threshold

Numeric. SD threshold for flagging. Default 2.

outlier_n_funnel

Integer. Minimum n for funnel plot inclusion. Default 20.

Value

A named list:

  • $residual_model_results — school × year × subject: observed, predicted, residual, sd_residual, outlier_flag, n_tested

  • $positive_outlier_schools — subset with outlier_flag == "high"

  • $negative_outlier_schools — subset with outlier_flag == "low"

  • $outlier_stability — school × subject: n_years_flagged, direction

  • $funnel_plot_data — school × year × subject: proficiency, n_tested, state_pct, upper_95, lower_95, upper_99, lower_99

  • $outlier_characteristics — NULL (requires school_results_long)
